culprit_citations.quoted_text: CCBlue Bidco, Inc. subtotal: 26,322 cost, 26,223 fair value, 21,790 prior value, 2.22 percent

findings.detail: The 26,223 thousand fair-value subtotal for CCBlue Bidco, Inc. ties to the 26.223 million residual and should not be treated as an independent income-identity unit.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation found the filing income statement itself reconciles: 2025 investment income components in table 22 rows 4-8 sum to total investment income of 150,258, and table 13 repeats the rounded 150.3 million total. The flagged residual is not supported by an income-source line; it matches the 26,223 thousand subtotal line for CCBlue Bidco, Inc. in the investment schedule, indicating a subtotal leaked into the identity population.
